<div class="card card-retractable" style="margin-bottom: 2rem;" onclick="this.classList.toggle('expanded')">

  <p style="text-align: center;font-weight: bold; font-size: 28px;">
  Challenges
  </p>

  <div style="text-align: justify;">

  If GP regression is a **highly abstract and mathematically complex concept**; it's combination with hierarchical modelling makes it even more complicated. The correct application of GPMelt to concrete and domain-specific biological data relies on a basic understanding of **how a biological experimental design is mathematically translated into a hierachy**. Moreover, adoption of this new framework depends on **lowering the rejection barrier linked to maths incomprehension**.
  
  The target audiences range from:

  - **biologists** with little statistical background;
  - to **bio-informaticians and bio-statisticians** whose middle to strong statistical background might not cover GP regression.

  </div>

  <div style="text-align: justify;">
  The key is to **translate similar concepts across multiple levels of abstraction without losing clarity or rigor, while sparking interest and enthusiasm.**
  </div>

  </div>

<div class="card-row">
  
  <div class="card card-retractable" onclick="this.classList.toggle('expanded')">
  <p style="text-align: center;font-weight: bold; font-size: 28px;">
  Approach
  </p>

  I designed a set of **short, visual-first videos**, each tailored to a **specific audience level**, while keeping a **consistent conceptual backbone**.

  Key design choices:

  * focus on **conceptual understanding** before formal definitions;
  * adaptation of vocabulary and level of detail;
  * strong use of visual metaphors, color coding, and animation;
  * **progressive abstraction** (from intuition to formalization).

  </div>

  <div class="card card-retractable" onclick="this.classList.toggle('expanded')">
  <p style="text-align: center;font-weight: bold; font-size: 28px;">
  Strengths
  </p>
  * Ability to **adapt** explanations to different audiences;
  * deep concept simplification **without oversimplification**;
  * **translation between disciplines** (from biological data to mathematical modeling; from statistical analysis to biological interpretation);
  * design of **structured learning pathways** (from intuition to formalization);
  * **high-quality visual** communication (figures, animation, storytelling);
  * creation of **concise, engaging educational** video content.
  </div>

</div>

<div class="card card-retractable" style="margin-bottom: 2rem;" onclick="this.classList.toggle('expanded')">

<p style="text-align: center;font-weight: bold; font-size: 28px;">
Impact
</p>
As a statistician developping tools for biologists, the **risk is to deliver a black box** that users might use eyes closed, without trying to understand what's happening behind the scene. This general lack of understanding of statistical methods is at the **origin of the numerous incorrect data analysis leading to inapropriate results and interpretation** which can nowadays be found throughout the litterature. <br>
By providing videos and figures to explain the theory and model behind GPMelt to diverse audiances, my goal is to **bridge the knowledge gap existing betweeen those generating the data and those analysing them**. Only then can data analysis become **truely powerful and lead to new discoveries**.
</div>
